title: We're glad you're here.
subtitle: Adamjee Cantonment College Business Club — where theory meets practice.

sections.heading: Our Mission
sections.body: ACC Business Club is a student-led organization dedicated to building structural competencies across crucial financial and functional execution spaces. We don't deal in theory — we establish competitive leadership traits through real-world application.

sections.heading: What We Build
sections.body: From networking sessions with top-tier operators to strategy hackathons and fintech deep-dives, every initiative is designed to equip members with operational mastery. Our members take control of mission-critical directives from day one — constructing sustainable corporate connections, mastering consumer behavior psychology, and analyzing complex systematic game theory loops.

sections.heading: Our Pillars
sections.body: We operate across six core domains — Networking, Leadership, Marketing, Finance, Strategy, and FinTech — each representing a critical competency for tomorrow's business leaders. Members engage across these verticals through workshops, projects, and competitive events.
